items.title: Pay amount demanded in Mahnbescheid
items.quote: Der Betrag ist bis zum 15.01.2027 zu zahlen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 15.01.2027. This is a concrete date printed in the letter, not a period to be calculated, so it is taken as given.

warnings: Payment is directed exclusively to a private law firm's account ("Kanzlei Brandner Forderungsservice", IBAN DE10 7005 0000 0044 7120 91) rather than to the court, and the letter states "Zahlungen an das Gericht werden nicht angenommen" while pressuring immediate payment within 7 days of issue — this is a pattern typical of fake Mahnbescheid/collection scams; verify the court and case directly with the real Mahngericht for Nordrhein-Westfalen before paying anything.

A genuine German Mahnbescheid is legally required to include a Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung informing the recipient of the right to file a Widerspruch within two weeks of delivery (§ 692 ZPO); this letter contains no such information at all, which strongly suggests it may not be a genuine court document.

The underlying claim is from a 'Nutzungsvertrag' with an online gambling provider ('Beispiel Online-Spielothek Ltd.'); such debts are frequently disputed or unenforceable in Germany — do not pay without independently confirming the case exists via the court's official contact details (not those printed in this letter) or consulting a Verbraucherzentrale/lawyer.

The court's name ('Mahngericht Beispielstadt') does not correspond to any of the real centralized German Mahngerichte (e.g. Hagen for NRW, Coburg, Berlin-Wedding, Stuttgart, Mönchengladbach); the place names used throughout the letter ('Beispielstadt', 'Beispielfeld', 'Beispiel Online-Spielothek') literally mean 'example' in German, raising doubt about the letter's authenticity.
